name: Coordination-critical variable identification
definition: Identify task variables whose plausible interpretations can materially alter downstream work.

name: Actor-indexed first-order apparent state
definition: Represent each actor's apparent task interpretation or commitment without claiming access to private mental states.

name: Recursive or second-order Theory of Mind state
definition: Represent bounded hypotheses about what one actor appears to take another actor to understand or commit to.

name: Observable public evidence and grounding status
definition: Inventory public utterances, acknowledgements, artifacts, policies, and actions relevant to whether an interpretation is publicly established.

name: Public warrant and promotion control
definition: Assess whether available public evidence is sufficient to promote an interpretation into action-guiding coordination commitment.

name: Action sensitivity and counterfactual consequence
definition: Compare plausible interpretations by their materially different downstream plans, permissions, schedules, resources, responsibilities, or artifacts.

name: Incomplete-context handling, uncertainty, and abstention
definition: Expose missing context and uncertainty, and abstain when the evidence is insufficient for a defensible diagnostic.

name: Evidence-backed observability, contestability, and diagnostic evaluation
definition: Expose the evidence, competing interpretations, warrant basis, proposed transition, and consequences so a human can inspect and challenge the diagnostic.
